blocks.prompt: 7. Multiply \(z_1 = 2(\cos 60^{\circ} + i\sin 60^{\circ})\) and \(z_2 = 5(\cos 90^{\circ} + i\sin 90^{\circ})\) and express in \(x + iy\) form.
blocks.explanation: Yeh do complex numbers ka zarb (product) hai, dono polar form mein. Polar form ka sab se bara faida yahi hai: zarb mein lambaiyan (moduli) zarb hoti hain aur angles (arguments) jama. Humein \(z_1 z_2\) nikaal kar \(x + iy\) mein likhna hai. Plan: \(2 \times 5\), \(60^{\circ} + 90^{\circ}\), phir \(150^{\circ}\) ki exact values; aakhir mein rectangular form mein zarb kar ke check.
steps:
Given (diya gaya hai): \(r_1 = 2\), \(\theta_1 = 60^{\circ}\); \(r_2 = 5\), \(\theta_2 = 90^{\circ}\).
To find (maloom karna hai): \(z_1 z_2\), \(x + iy\) form mein.
Method (tareeqa): polar form ka product rule, kyunke dono numbers \(r(\cos\theta + i\sin\theta)\) ki shakal mein hain.

Qadam 1: Product rule likhein
\[z_1 z_2 = r_1 r_2\,[\cos(\theta_1 + \theta_2)\]
\[+\, i\sin(\theta_1 + \theta_2)]\]
Kyun: polar form mein zarb karne se moduli zarb aur arguments jama hote hain. Kitab ne yeh \(\cos(A + B)\) aur \(\sin(A + B)\) ke formulas se saabit kiya hai.

Qadam 2: Values rakhein
\[r_1 r_2 = 2 \times 5 = 10\]
\[\theta_1 + \theta_2 = 60^{\circ} + 90^{\circ} = 150^{\circ}\]
\[z_1 z_2 = 10(\cos 150^{\circ} + i\sin 150^{\circ})\]
Kyun: seedha rule mein values rakhin.
Dhyan dein: moduli ko jama na karein (\(2 + 5\)) aur angles ko zarb na karein (\(60 \times 90\)); ulta kaam bohat aam ghalti hai.

Qadam 3: \(x + iy\) form mein badlein
\[\cos 150^{\circ} = -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[\sin 150^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[z_1 z_2 = 10\left(-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \dfrac{1}{2}i\right)\]
\[= -5\sqrt{3} + 5i\]
Kyun: \(150^{\circ}\) second quadrant mein hai (reference angle \(30^{\circ}\)), is liye cos negative aur sin positive. Phir 10 andar zarb kiya.

Tasdeeq (check): rectangular form mein zarb karein.
\[z_1 = 1 + i\sqrt{3}, \quad z_2 = 5i\]
\[z_1 z_2 = 5i + 5\sqrt{3}\,i^{2}\]
\[= -5\sqrt{3} + 5i \;✓\]
Kyun: \(z_1 = 2\left(\tfrac{1}{2} + \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}i\right)\) aur \(z_2 = 5(0 + i)\); zarb mein \(i^{2} = -1\) lagaya. Dono tareeqon se ek hi jawab aana chahiye, aur aaya.
Ek baat aur: \(z_2 = 5i\) se zarb karne ka matlab hai \(z_1\) ko \(90^{\circ}\) ghumana aur 5 guna lamba karna. Isi liye \(60^{\circ}\) \(150^{\circ}\) ban gaya.
